definition_en: People who study a subject in detail to discover new information.
example_en: The researchers published their findings in a prestigious scientific journal today.
example_uz: Tadqiqotchilar o'z topilmalarini bugun nufuzli ilmiy jurnalda nashr etdilar.

definition_en: A vehicle without an engine that is pulled by a car or truck to carry goods.
example_en: At the end of the day, we put the snowmobiles back on the trailer.
example_uz: Kun oxirida biz qor mototsikllarini yana tirkamaga yukladik.

definition_en: To stop receiving emails or updates from a service or mailing list.
example_en: How do I unsubscribe from your weekly email newsletter?
example_uz: Sizning haftalik elektron xabarnomangizdan qanday obunani bekor qilsam bo'ladi?

definition_en: Belonging to a very old time and usually valuable because of its age.
example_en: They sell beautiful antique furniture in that small shop downtown.
example_uz: Ular shahar markazidagi kichik do'konda go'zal qadimiy mebellarni sotishadi.

definition_en: Relating to the smallest units of a chemical substance.
example_en: Scientists are studying the molecular structure of this new virus.
example_uz: Olimlar ushbu yangi virusning molekulyar tuzilishini o'rganmoqdalar.

definition_en: The place where a person lives or stays.
example_en: The prime minister arrived at his official residence late last night.
example_uz: Bosh vazir o'zining rasmiy qarorgohiga kecha kechasi yetib keldi.

definition_en: The number of things or people in a specific area or space.
example_en: The city has a very high population density in the center.
example_uz: Shaharning markazida aholi zichligi juda yuqori.

definition_en: The number that is ten times ten.
example_en: I have one hundred dollars to spend on my new phone.
example_uz: Menda yangi telefonimga sarflash uchun yuz dollar bor.

definition_en: Different from what is usual or expected; odd or unfamiliar.
example_en: I heard a strange noise coming from the kitchen last night.
example_uz: O'tgan kecha oshxonadan g'alati shovqin eshitdim.

definition_en: Relating to information expressed in numbers.
example_en: The report provides statistical evidence to support the new government policy.
example_uz: Hisobot yangi hukumat siyosatini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun statistik dalillarni taqdim etadi.

definition_en: The color between black and white, like the color of ash or smoke.
example_en: The sky turned grey before the heavy rain started to fall down.
example_uz: Kuchli yomg'ir yog'ishidan oldin osmon kulrang tusga kirdi.

definition_en: Two lines that stay the same distance apart and never meet each other.
example_en: The two railway lines run parallel to the main road for miles.
example_uz: Temir yo'lning ikki qatori asosiy yo'lga parallel ravishda bir necha mil cho'zilgan.

definition_en: To work or function in a specific way, or to control a machine.
example_en: The workers were trained to operate the new machines in the factory.
example_uz: Ishchilar zavoddagi yangi mashinalarni boshqarishga o'rgatilgan edi.

definition_en: Someone who is not afraid to do difficult or dangerous things.
example_en: She made a bold decision to quit her job and start painting.
example_uz: U ishini tashlab, rasm chizishni boshlash haqida dadil qaror qabul qildi.

definition_en: A type of musical play where the words are sung instead of spoken.
example_en: We went to the theater to see a famous Italian opera performance.
example_uz: Biz mashhur italyan operasi tomoshasini ko'rish uchun teatrga bordik.

definition_en: To look at something quickly to find specific information or convert to digital.
example_en: I need to scan these important documents before sending them by email.
example_uz: Ushbu muhim hujjatlarni elektron pochta orqali yuborishdan oldin ularni skanerlashim kerak.

definition_en: Something you say, feel, or do because of something that has happened.
example_en: The announcement of the verdict brought a strong reaction from the crowd.
example_uz: Hukmning e'lon qilinishi olomondan kuchli reaksiya keltirib chiqardi.

definition_en: Empty with no writing, pictures, or marks on it.
example_en: Please write your name at the top of the blank page.
example_uz: Iltimos ismingizni bo'sh varaqning yuqori qismiga yozing.

definition_en: Having the official right to do or have something.
example_en: If you are injured at work you are entitled to compensation.
example_uz: Agar siz ishda jarohat olsangiz, tovon puli olishga haqlisiz.

definition_en: Very serious, extreme, or unpleasant.
example_en: The country is suffering from a severe shortage of clean water.
example_uz: Mamlakat toza suvning qattiq tanqisligidan aziyat chekmoqda.

definition_en: A type of metal that does not rust or change color easily.
example_en: Most of my kitchen knives are made of stainless steel.
example_uz: Oshxona pichoqlarimning ko'pchiligi zanglamaydigan po'latdan yasalgan.

definition_en: Of very high quality and more expensive than standard versions.
example_en: They decided to book a deluxe room for their wedding anniversary.
example_uz: Ular to'y yilligi uchun hashamatli xonani band qilishga qaror qilishdi.

definition_en: The ability to be funny or the quality of being amusing.
example_en: He has a great sense of humor and makes everyone laugh.
example_uz: U juda yaxshi hazil tuyg'usiga ega va barchani kuldiradi.

definition_en: A person or thing that is not included in a general rule.
example_en: Everyone must follow the rules, and there is no exception.
example_uz: Hamma qoidalarga amal qilishi kerak va bu yerda hech qanday istisno yo'q.

definition_en: Achieving the desired result or finishing something well without failing.
example_en: They successfully completed their project together after working hard for weeks.
example_uz: Ular haftalar davomida qattiq ishlab loyihalarini muvaffaqiyatli yakunlashdi.

definition_en: For the most part; mainly or for the most important reason.
example_en: The study was primarily designed to understand the impact of climate change.
example_uz: Tadqiqot asosan iqlim o'zgarishining ta'sirini tushunish uchun ishlab chiqilgan edi.

definition_en: Held firmly in place or not having enough room to move easily.
example_en: The passageway was so tight that we could barely walk through it.
example_uz: Yo'lak shunchalik tor ediki, biz u yerdan zo'rg'a o'ta oldik.

definition_en: The qualities or abilities that allow a person or thing to do something.
example_en: The software has advanced capabilities for processing large amounts of complex data.
example_uz: Dasturiy ta'minot katta hajmdagi murakkab ma'lumotlarni qayta ishlash uchun ilg'or imkoniyatlarga ega.

definition_en: A clear difference between two or more people, objects, or ideas.
example_en: There is a sharp contrast between the lifestyle of the rich and poor.
example_uz: Boylar va kambag'allar turmush tarzi o'rtasida keskin farq bor.

definition_en: An official suggestion about which person or thing is best for a job.
example_en: I got the job based on the recommendation of my former boss.
example_uz: Men sobiq xo'jayinimning tavsiyasi bilan ishga kirdim.

definition_en: The process of finding new people to join an organization or company.
example_en: The company started a recruitment drive to find talented young software engineers.
example_uz: Kompaniya iste'dodli yosh dasturiy ta'minot muhandislarini topish uchun yollash kampaniyasini boshladi.

definition_en: An act that is against religious or moral rules.
example_en: In many cultures, it is considered a sin to steal from others.
example_uz: Ko'pgina madaniyatlarda boshqalardan o'g'irlash gunoh hisoblanadi.

definition_en: Pleasing and attractive, often in a small or young way.
example_en: Look at that cute puppy playing in the garden with the ball.
example_uz: Bog'da to'p bilan o'ynayotgan o'sha yoqimli kuchukka qarang.

definition_en: Someone who is able to plan their work and time well and be tidy.
example_en: You are so organized because you keep all your files in folders.
example_uz: Siz juda tartiblirsiz chunki barcha fayllaringizni papkalarda saqlaysiz.

definition_en: A short piece of writing that is part of a longer document or text.
example_en: Please write one more para to explain your idea clearly.
example_uz: Iltimos fikringizni aniq tushuntirish uchun yana bitta xatboshi yozing.

definition_en: A scientific unit used to measure how easily electricity moves through a material.
example_en: The electrical conductance of the wire is measured in siemens.
example_uz: Simning elektr o'tkazuvchanligi simenslarda o'lchanadi.

definition_en: The legal act of taking a child into your family and becoming their parent.
example_en: They decided to go through the adoption process to start their family.
example_uz: Ular oila qurish uchun asrab olish jarayonidan o'tishga qaror qilishdi.

definition_en: The past tense of mean; to have a specific purpose or intended meaning.
example_en: I am sorry, I meant to send that email to you yesterday.
example_uz: Kechirasiz men u xatni kecha sizga yubormoqchi edim.

definition_en: To catch someone or something, or to record an image or feeling perfectly.
example_en: The photographer tried to capture the beauty of the sunset in pictures.
example_uz: Fotosuratchi quyosh botishining go'zalligini suratlarda muhrlashga urindi.

definition_en: The currency of the United Kingdom or a unit of weight measurement.
example_en: The ticket costs fifty pounds, which is quite expensive for us.
example_uz: Chipta ellik funt turadi bu biz uchun ancha qimmat.

definition_en: A large wild animal that looks like a cow, often found in nature.
example_en: We saw a large buffalo grazing in the fields during our trip.
example_uz: Sayohatimiz davomida dalada o'tlab yurgan katta buyvolni ko'rdik.

definition_en: To want something very much.
example_en: I desire to speak with you about our future plans today.
example_uz: Men siz bilan bugun kelajak rejalarimiz haqida gaplashishni istayman.

definition_en: Objects like rings or necklaces that people wear to look beautiful.
example_en: The jewellery she wore at the party was very expensive.
example_uz: U bazmda taqib yurgan taqinchoqlar juda qimmat edi.

definition_en: Past tense of catch; to take hold of something that is moving.
example_en: He caught the ball just before it hit the ground.
example_uz: U to'pni yerga tegmasdan oldin tutib oldi.

definition_en: Something that happens at the end of a long period or process.
example_en: She practiced every day and eventually learned to play the piano.
example_uz: U har kuni mashq qildi va oxir-oqibat pianino chalishni o'rgandi.

definition_en: Determined to achieve success and working very hard to do it.
example_en: She is a highly driven student who always completes her work early.
example_uz: U har doim ishini erta yakunlaydigan juda intiluvchan talaba.

definition_en: A container with a narrow neck used to hold liquids.
example_en: Could you please bring me a bottle of cold water?
example_uz: Iltimos menga bir shisha sovuq suv olib kela olasizmi?

definition_en: Using new ideas or methods that have never been used before.
example_en: The company is famous for its innovative approach to modern technology.
example_uz: Kompaniya zamonaviy texnologiyalarga innovatsion yondashuvi bilan mashhur.

definition_en: A high-ranking officer in the army or a person in charge of public events.
example_en: The fire marshall gave us instructions on how to leave the building.
example_uz: Olov marshali bizga binodan qanday chiqib ketish bo'yicha ko'rsatmalar berdi.

definition_en: Rubbing and pressing the body to help someone relax or to reduce pain.
example_en: Having a massage can have many beneficial effects on your sore muscles.
example_uz: Massaj olish og'riyotgan mushaklaringizga juda ko'p ijobiy ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin.

definition_en: A flexible material made from tree sap or chemicals, often used for making tires.
example_en: Please use a rubber to remove the pencil marks from your notebook.
example_uz: Iltimos daftaringizdagi qalam izlarini o'chirish uchun o'chirg'ichdan foydalaning.

definition_en: The final part of something or a decision reached after thinking carefully.
example_en: The board came to the conclusion that the plan was not practical.
example_uz: Kengash rejaning amaliy emasligi haqidagi xulosaga keldi.

definition_en: The number that is equal to ten hundreds.
example_en: The company earned fifty thousand dollars in profit last month.
example_uz: Kompaniya o'tgan oyda ellik ming dollar foyda ko'rdi.

definition_en: A very old and famous story that may not be completely true.
example_en: The legend of King Arthur is known in many countries around the world.
example_uz: Qirol Artur haqidagi afsona dunyoning ko'plab mamlakatlarida mashhur.

definition_en: A smooth, attractive way of moving or behaving.
example_en: The dancer moved across the stage with elegance and natural grace.
example_uz: Raqsga tushuvchi sahnada nafosat va tabiiy lutf bilan harakat qildi.

definition_en: A large, strong snake that kills other animals by squeezing them tightly.
example_en: The giant python rested silently on the branch of a large tree.
example_uz: Ulkan piton katta daraxt shoxida jim o'tirardi.

definition_en: An imaginary, large, and very scary creature that can be dangerous.
example_en: The little boy was afraid that a monster lived under his bed.
example_uz: Kichkina bola karavoti ostida maxluq yashaydi deb qo'rqardi.

definition_en: A sudden, loud noise caused by something hitting an object or an explosion.
example_en: The door closed with a loud bang because of the strong wind.
example_uz: Kuchli shamol tufayli eshik qattiq tarsillab yopildi.

definition_en: A large and expensive house, often used for holidays in the countryside.
example_en: We spent our summer vacation in a beautiful villa by the sea.
example_uz: Biz yozgi ta'tilni dengiz bo'yidagi chiroyli villada o'tkazdik.

definition_en: One of the hard parts that form the skeleton of a human or animal.
example_en: The dog was happy to chew on a large bone in the garden.
example_uz: It bog'da katta suyakni kemirib o'tirganidan xursand edi.

definition_en: Medical problems or illnesses that affect the normal working of the body or mind.
example_en: The doctor is studying sleep disorders to help patients get better rest.
example_uz: Shifokor bemorlarga yaxshi dam olishga yordam berish uchun uyqu buzilishlarini o'rganmoqda.

definition_en: The act of working together with other people to create or achieve something.
example_en: Successful business growth often requires close collaboration between different company departments.
example_uz: Muvaffaqiyatli biznes o'sishi ko'pincha kompaniyaning turli bo'limlari o'rtasida yaqin hamkorlikni talab qiladi.

definition_en: The process of noticing or discovering something that is hard to see or find.
example_en: Early detection of the disease allows for more effective medical treatment plans.
example_uz: Kasallikni erta aniqlash yanada samarali tibbiy davolash rejalarini yaratishga imkon beradi.

definition_en: Small, flat, sweet baked goods that are often eaten as a snack.
example_en: My grandmother baked some delicious chocolate cookies for us this afternoon.
example_uz: Buvim bugun tushdan keyin biz uchun mazali shokoladli pechenyelar pishirdi.

definition_en: Located inside or closer to the middle of something.
example_en: She keeps her most valuable belongings in an inner pocket of her bag.
example_uz: U o'zining eng qimmatbaho buyumlarini sumkasining ichki cho'ntagida saqlaydi.

definition_en: The way in which something is made or the process of coming together.
example_en: The formation of new stars is a long and complex space process.
example_uz: Yangi yulduzlarning shakllanishi uzoq va murakkab kosmik jarayondir.

definition_en: A short lesson or video guide that explains how to do a specific task.
example_en: I watched an online tutorial to learn how to use this software.
example_uz: Men ushbu dasturdan foydalanishni o'rganish uchun onlayn qo'llanmani ko'rdim.

definition_en: A movable barrier used to close an entrance in a wall or fence.
example_en: Please make sure to close the gate when you leave the house.
example_uz: Uydan chiqayotganingizda darvozani yopib qo'yganingizga ishonch hosil qiling.

definition_en: An object that is used to hold or support something else.
example_en: She placed her toothbrush in the holder by the bathroom sink.
example_uz: U tish cho'tkasini hammomdagi idishga joylab qo'ydi.

definition_en: A person who leads a discussion to ensure rules are followed correctly.
example_en: The forum moderator deleted the offensive comment from the public chat.
example_uz: Forum moderatori haqoratli izohni ommaviy chatdan o'chirib tashladi.

definition_en: A place where people have come to live and build houses.
example_en: Archaeologists found evidence of an ancient human settlement near the river.
example_uz: Arxeologlar daryo yaqinida qadimgi insonlar manzilgohi izlarini topdilar.

definition_en: Relating to the ancient city of Rome or its civilization.
example_en: We visited the remains of a beautiful Roman temple in Italy.
example_uz: Biz Italiyada go'zal Rim ibodatxonasi qoldiqlarini ko'rib chiqdik.

definition_en: Tasks or actions that someone is required to perform as part of their job.
example_en: Her duties include answering the phone and greeting visitors at the office.
example_uz: Uning majburiyatlariga telefon qo'ng'iroqlariga javob berish va tashrif buyuruvchilarni kutib olish kiradi.

definition_en: The quality of someone's voice that shows their feelings or attitude.
example_en: He spoke in a calm tone even though he was very angry.
example_uz: Juda g'azablangan bo'lsa ham, u xotirjam ohangda gapirdi.

definition_en: Items that people collect because they are interesting or might be valuable later.
example_en: Many people enjoy searching for rare coins and other valuable collectables.
example_uz: Ko'plab odamlar noyob tangalar va boshqa qimmatli kolleksiya buyumlarini izlashni yaxshi ko'rishadi.

definition_en: A system of accepted beliefs about what is morally right or wrong.
example_en: The company was accused of violating basic business ethics to save money.
example_uz: Kompaniya pul tejash maqsadida asosiy biznes etikasini buzishda ayblandi.

definition_en: For all future time; at all times.
example_en: They promised to be best friends forever during their childhood years.
example_uz: Ular bolalik yillarida abadiy eng yaqin do'st bo'lishga va'da berishdi.

definition_en: A large imaginary creature from stories that can breathe fire and fly.
example_en: The brave knight fought the dragon to save the kingdom from fire.
example_uz: Jasur ritsar qirollikni olovdan qutqarish uchun ajdarho bilan jang qildi.

definition_en: The person who is in charge of a ship, an aircraft, or a sports team.
example_en: The captain led the team to victory in the final championship game.
example_uz: Kapitan jamoani chempionatning final o'yinida g'alabaga yetakladi.

definition_en: Extremely good or very pleasing.
example_en: We had a fantastic time at the beach yesterday afternoon.
example_uz: Biz kecha tushdan keyin sohil bo'yida ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik.

definition_en: The part of the body that connects your head to your shoulders.
example_en: I have a pain in my neck after working all day.
example_uz: Butun kun ishlaganimdan keyin bo'ynim og'riyapti.

definition_en: The part of a bird or insect used for flying.
example_en: The bird was flapping its wings while trying to fly.
example_uz: Qush uchishga urinayotganda qanotlarini qoqayotgan edi.

definition_en: Sound equipment that plays music through two separate speakers.
example_en: She likes to play music on her stereo at home.
example_uz: U uyda stereosida musiqa tinglashni yaxshi ko'radi.

definition_en: The flavor that you feel when you eat or drink something.
example_en: This soup has a very strange taste, I do not like it.
example_uz: Bu sho'rvaning ta'mi juda g'alati, menga yoqmayapti.

definition_en: Extremely small in size or amount.
example_en: There was a tiny insect crawling on the kitchen table.
example_uz: Oshxona stolida sudralib yurgan mitti hasharot bor edi.

definition_en: Working correctly and ready to be used.
example_en: The new factory is now fully operational after the recent repairs.
example_uz: Yangi zavod yaqinda qilingan ta'mirdan so'ng to'liq ishga tushdi.

definition_en: The railway system as a method of transport for people or goods.
example_en: We decided to travel to the city by rail this summer.
example_uz: Bu yoz shaharga temir yo'l orqali borishga qaror qildik.

definition_en: Giving or using something in large amounts; willing to allow different opinions.
example_en: He was very liberal with his money when his friends needed help.
example_uz: Do‘stlari yordamga muhtoj bo‘lganda u pulini ayamadi.

definition_en: A camera connected to the internet that shows live video of a place.
example_en: We watched the city square through the livecam on our website.
example_uz: Biz veb-saytimizdagi jonli kamera orqali shahar maydonini kuzatdik.

definition_en: A space or opening between two things.
example_en: He managed to squeeze through a small gap in the fence.
example_uz: U panjaradagi kichik tirqishdan o‘tib ketishga muvaffaq bo‘ldi.

definition_en: A hidden place to store things or a digital memory for temporary data.
example_en: Clear your browser cache if the website is not loading correctly.
example_uz: Agar veb-sayt to‘g‘ri yuklanmasa, brauzer keshini tozalang.

definition_en: A method of making still pictures appear to move.
example_en: The children enjoyed watching the new animation at the cinema today.
example_uz: Bolalar bugun kinoteatrda yangi animatsiyani tomosha qilishdan zavqlandilar.

definition_en: A person or thing thought to give wise, prophetic advice.
example_en: The king went to the oracle to seek advice about his future.
example_uz: Qirol kelajagi haqida maslahat so‘rash uchun bashoratchiga bordi.

definition_en: To pay money to use someone else's property for a specific period of time.
example_en: I am leasing a small apartment in the city for one year.
example_uz: Men shaharda bir yilga kichik kvartira ijaraga olyapman.

definition_en: The activities involved in flying, designing, or building aircraft.
example_en: He works in the aviation industry as a commercial airline pilot.
example_uz: U aviatsiya sohasida tijorat aviakompaniyasi uchuvchisi bo'lib ishlaydi.

definition_en: An amount that is more than is necessary, acceptable, or usual.
example_en: You should cut out any excess fat from your daily diet.
example_uz: Siz kundalik taomnomangizdan ortiqcha yog'larni chiqarib tashlashingiz kerak.

definition_en: A very bad event that causes a lot of damage or destruction.
example_en: The earthquake was a natural disaster that destroyed many local homes.
example_uz: Zilzila ko'plab mahalliy uylarni vayron qilgan tabiiy ofat edi.

definition_en: To comfort someone who is sad or disappointed.
example_en: I tried to console her after she heard the sad news.
example_uz: U yomon xabarni eshitgach uni yupatishga harakat qildim.

definition_en: The technology of sending information over long distances using electronic systems.
example_en: Modern telecommunications allow us to talk to anyone across the world.
example_uz: Zamonaviy telekommunikatsiyalar bizga dunyoning istalgan nuqtasidagi odam bilan gaplashish imkonini beradi.

definition_en: A person who teaches a skill or subject to students.
example_en: The driving instructor helped me learn how to park the car safely.
example_uz: Haydash bo'yicha yo'riqchi menga mashinani xavfsiz to'xtashni o'rgatdi.

definition_en: Something that is extremely large in size or scale.
example_en: We saw a giant tree growing in the middle of the park.
example_uz: Biz parkning o'rtasida o'sayotgan ulkan daraxtni ko'rdik.

definition_en: To send goods from one place to another by ship or other transport.
example_en: The store shipped my new computer to me early this morning.
example_uz: Do'kon mening yangi kompyuterimni bugun erta tongda yubordi.

definition_en: A sound or device that warns people of danger.
example_en: The smoke alarm went off when I burned my toast in class.
example_uz: Men tostni yoqib yuborganimda tutun signali ishga tushib ketdi.

definition_en: The force of an electric current, measured in volts.
example_en: The machine requires a high voltage to work properly every day.
example_uz: Mashina har kuni to'g'ri ishlashi uchun yuqori kuchlanish talab qiladi.

definition_en: A Japanese company that makes electronic video games and game consoles.
example_en: He spends most of his free time playing games on his Nintendo.
example_uz: U bo'sh vaqtining ko'p qismini Nintendo'da o'yin o'ynash bilan o'tkazadi.

definition_en: Happening or being done most of the time; common.
example_en: I will meet you at the usual time after my work ends.
example_uz: Men siz bilan ishim tugagandan so'ng odatiy vaqtda uchrashaman.

definition_en: Small paper squares that you stick on envelopes to pay for mailing letters.
example_en: You need to put some stamps on the envelope before you mail it.
example_uz: Xatni jo'natishdan oldin konvertga pochta markalarini yopishtirishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A historical term for a landowner in the middle ages who was not noble.
example_en: The franklin was a wealthy landowner in medieval English society.
example_uz: Franklin o'rta asrlar ingliz jamiyatidagi boy yer egasi edi.

definition_en: The space between two lines that meet at a point, measured in degrees.
example_en: You can measure the angle of the corner using a ruler.
example_uz: Siz chizg'ich yordamida burchakning darajasini o'lchashingiz mumkin.

definition_en: To steal money or property from a person or place, often using force.
example_en: It is a serious crime to rob a bank or a store.
example_uz: Bank yoki do'konni talash og'ir jinoyat hisoblanadi.

definition_en: A type of strong plastic, often used for old-fashioned music records.
example_en: Many music fans prefer to listen to music on vinyl records.
example_uz: Ko'plab musiqa ixlosmandlari musiqani vinil plastinkalarda tinglashni afzal ko'rishadi.

definition_en: The most interesting or exciting parts of an event or sports match.
example_en: I watched the highlights of the football game on the news tonight.
example_uz: Men bugun yangiliklarda futbol o'yinining eng muhim qismlarini tomosha qildim.

definition_en: The industry or activity of digging coal, gold, or other minerals from the earth.
example_en: The gold mining industry provides many jobs for people in this region.
example_uz: Oltin qazib olish sanoati ushbu hududdagi odamlar uchun ko'plab ish o'rinlarini taqdim etadi.

definition_en: Of the lowest quality or the most unpleasant.
example_en: This was the worst movie that I have ever seen in cinema.
example_uz: Bu men kinoteatrda ko'rgan eng yomon film edi.

definition_en: The activity of risking money on the result of a game or event.
example_en: He lost a lot of money because of his betting on football.
example_uz: Futbolga tikkan pullari tufayli u ko'p pul yo'qotdi.

definition_en: People who study the physical world and nature through observation and experiments.
example_en: Scientists are working hard to find a cure for this dangerous disease.
example_uz: Olimlar ushbu xavfli kasallikka davo topish uchun qattiq mehnat qilmoqdalar.

definition_en: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority.
example_en: The citizens of the country fought hard for their liberty and rights.
example_uz: Mamlakat fuqarolari o'z ozodligi va huquqlari uchun qattiq kurashdilar.

definition_en: A popular card game where players try to get a total card value of 21.
example_en: We spent the evening in the casino playing blackjack with some friends.
example_uz: Biz kechqurun kazinoda do'stlarimiz bilan blekjek o'ynab o'tirdik.

definition_en: A large country located in the southern part of South America.
example_en: I have always wanted to visit the beautiful country of Argentina someday.
example_uz: Men qachondir Argentina kabi go'zal mamlakatga borishni doimo orzu qilganman.

definition_en: A chance that something may happen or be true.
example_en: There is a strong possibility that it will rain later this afternoon.
example_uz: Bugun tushdan keyin yomg'ir yog'ish ehtimoli juda yuqori.

definition_en: A person whose job is to study data or information in detail.
example_en: The financial analyst examined the company reports to identify any major problems.
example_uz: Moliya tahlilchisi asosiy muammolarni aniqlash uchun kompaniya hisobotlarini ko'rib chiqdi.

definition_en: An official person who is in charge of a department or organization.
example_en: The police commissioner announced new safety rules for the entire city today.
example_uz: Politsiya komissari bugun butun shahar uchun yangi xavfsizlik qoidalarini e'lon qildi.

definition_en: A building where you keep your car or other vehicles safe.
example_en: Please park your car in the garage so it stays dry tonight.
example_uz: Iltimos, mashinangizni garajga qo'ying, shunda u kechasi quruq qoladi.

definition_en: Making you feel very happy and enthusiastic about something.
example_en: We watched a very exciting football match at the stadium last night.
example_uz: Biz kecha stadionda juda qiziqarli futbol o'yinini tomosha qildik.

definition_en: The quality of being able to be trusted to do what is expected.
example_en: The company is famous for the reliability of its high quality products.
example_uz: Kompaniya o'zining yuqori sifatli mahsulotlarining ishonchliligi bilan mashhur.

definition_en: A type of light shoe that is held on by a strap between toes.
example_en: I wore my comfortable thongs while walking along the sandy beach today.
example_uz: Men bugun qumli plyaj bo'ylab yurar ekanman, qulay shippaklarimni kiyib oldim.

definition_en: Used to say that something is sad or disappointing.
example_en: Unfortunately, the store was closed when we arrived there last night.
example_uz: Afsuski, biz u yerga yetib borganimizda do'kon yopiq edi.

definition_en: In the order already mentioned.
example_en: John and Alice are ten and twelve years old, respectively.
example_uz: Jon va Elis mos ravishda o'n va o'n ikki yoshda.

definition_en: A feeling of love or strong connection to someone or something.
example_en: He felt a strong attachment to his old family home.
example_uz: U o'zining eski ota-ona uyiga kuchli mehr qo'ygan edi.

definition_en: A sound that a mobile phone makes when someone calls you.
example_en: I changed my ringtone to a song I really like.
example_uz: Men qo'ng'iroq ohangimni o'zimga yoqadigan qo'shiqqa o'zgartirdim.

definition_en: A feeling of happiness and enjoyment.
example_en: It was a great pleasure to meet your family today.
example_uz: Bugun oilangiz bilan tanishganimdan juda mamnun bo'ldim.

definition_en: To fulfill a promise or to show great respect for someone or something.
example_en: You should always honor your promise to help your friends in need.
example_uz: Do'stlaringizga yordam berish haqidagi va'dangizni doimo bajarishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A piece of clothing that covers each leg separately, usually reaching to the ankles.
example_en: I need to buy a new pair of black pants for work.
example_uz: Men ish uchun yangi qora shim sotib olishim kerak.

definition_en: The act of speaking to God or a spiritual power to show respect.
example_en: Many people find peace and comfort through the act of daily prayer.
example_uz: Ko'p odamlar kundalik ib duolar orqali xotirjamlik va tasalli topadilar.

definition_en: A very powerful tropical storm with extremely strong and dangerous rotating winds.
example_en: The coastal city prepared for the hurricane by boarding up all windows.
example_uz: Qirg'oq bo'yidagi shahar dovulga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun barcha derazalarni taxtalar bilan yopdi.

definition_en: Events that happen to you by chance, often bringing success or good results.
example_en: I had a bit of good luck and found my lost keys today.
example_uz: Bugun biroz omadim chopdi va yo'qotgan kalitlarimni topib oldim.

definition_en: The money you pay to send a letter or package through the mail system.
example_en: You need to add extra postage if you want to send this parcel.
example_uz: Agar ushbu posylkani yubormoqchi bo'lsangiz, qo'shimcha pochta to'lovini to'lashingiz kerak.

definition_en: A person or company that creates goods, or oversees the creation of a film.
example_en: The film producer worked hard to ensure the project was finished on time.
example_uz: Film prodyuseri loyihani o'z vaqtida yakunlash uchun qattiq ishladi.

definition_en: To press the buttons on a phone to call someone.
example_en: In an emergency you should dial 999 for the police.
example_uz: Favqulodda vaziyatda politsiyani chaqirish uchun 999 raqamini terishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Duties or tasks that you are required to do as part of your job.
example_en: My new job involves many responsibilities regarding the company budget.
example_uz: Yangi ishim kompaniya byudjeti bilan bog'liq ko'plab mas'uliyatlarni o'z ichiga oladi.

definition_en: A book or magazine that tells a story using drawn images.
example_en: The boy loves reading his favorite comic during the school break.
example_uz: Bola tanaffus paytida o'zining sevimli komiksini o'qishni yaxshi ko'radi.

definition_en: Doing something with a lot of attention to avoid mistakes.
example_en: She carefully placed the fragile vase on the wooden shelf.
example_uz: U mo'rt vazani yog'och tokchaga ehtiyotkorlik bilan qo'ydi.

definition_en: A powerful airplane that uses engines to fly at very high speeds.
example_en: The fast jet took off from the airport just before noon.
example_uz: Tezkor reaktiv samolyot tushdan oldin aeroportdan havoga ko'tarildi.

definition_en: A gold or metal headpiece worn by a king or queen.
example_en: The king wore a heavy gold crown at the royal ceremony.
example_uz: Qirol qirollik marosimida og'ir oltin toj kiygan edi.

definition_en: Located or operating beneath the surface of the earth.
example_en: The subway system in this city is entirely underground.
example_uz: Bu shahardagi metro tizimi to'liq yer ostida joylashgan.

definition_en: The process of identifying the cause of an illness or a problem.
example_en: The doctor made a diagnosis after reviewing all of the test results.
example_uz: Shifokor barcha tahlil natijalarini ko'rib chiqqach tashxis qo'ydi.

definition_en: A person or company that makes or produces a specific product.
example_en: This company is a famous maker of high-quality kitchen appliances.
example_uz: Bu kompaniya yuqori sifatli oshxona jihozlarining mashhur ishlab chiqaruvchisidir.

definition_en: To break or cause something to break without separating into distinct parts.
example_en: The dry ground began to crack during the hot summer months.
example_uz: Issiq yoz oylarida quruq yer yorila boshladi.

definition_en: A group of people, often young people, who spend time together and sometimes commit crimes.
example_en: Police are working hard to stop the local gang from causing trouble.
example_uz: Politsiya mahalliy to'daning muammo keltirib chiqarishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik uchun qattiq ishlamoqda.

definition_en: One of the two periods into which the academic year is divided.
example_en: Students have to study hard during their final semester at university.
example_uz: Talabalar universitetdagi oxirgi semestr davomida qattiq o'qishlari kerak.

definition_en: A strong and unusual sexual interest in a particular object or body part.
example_en: The study explores how society views the concept of a psychological fetish.
example_uz: Tadqiqot jamiyat psixologik fetish tushunchasiga qanday qarashini o'rganadi.

definition_en: To put something into use for a particular purpose or in a specific situation.
example_en: She applies her knowledge of science to solve real-world engineering problems.
example_uz: U muhandislikdagi haqiqiy muammolarni hal qilish uchun o'zining fan bilimlarini qo'llaydi.

definition_en: The way that someone or something looks to others.
example_en: He cares a lot about his physical appearance and always dresses well.
example_uz: U o'zining tashqi ko'rinishiga juda e'tibor beradi va doimo yaxshi kiyinadi.

definition_en: To breathe in and out smoke from a burning cigarette, cigar, or pipe.
example_en: He likes to smoke a pipe while reading his morning newspaper.
example_uz: U tonggi gazetasini o'qiyotganda trubka chekishni yaxshi ko'radi.

definition_en: A member of a group of Native American people from the southwestern United States.
example_en: The Apache tribe has a rich history in the American southwest.
example_uz: Apachi qabilasi Amerika janubi-g'arbida boy tarixga ega.

definition_en: To make something carefully using skill and your hands.
example_en: Local artists craft beautiful jewelry from silver and natural stones.
example_uz: Mahalliy rassomlar kumush va tabiiy toshlardan go'zal taqinchoqlar yasashadi.

definition_en: Separated by a distance or not together in one piece.
example_en: They live miles apart but stay in touch every single day.
example_uz: Ular bir-biridan uzoqda yashashsa-da, har kuni aloqada bo'lishadi.

definition_en: A person who is associated with another or belongs to the same group.
example_en: He is a kind fellow who always helps his neighbors in need.
example_uz: U muhtoj qo'shnilariga doimo yordam beradigan mehribon inson.

definition_en: Unable to see anything because of a medical condition.
example_en: The guide dog helps the blind person navigate through the busy street.
example_uz: Yo'l boshlovchi it ko'r kishiga gavjum ko'chadan o'tishga yordam beradi.

definition_en: To spend time relaxing in a lazy or comfortable way.
example_en: On sunny afternoons, we love to lounge in the garden chairs.
example_uz: Quyoshli tushdan keyin bog' stullarida dam olishni yaxshi ko'ramiz.

definition_en: Very angry or having a mental illness that makes you act strangely.
example_en: Are you mad at me for forgetting about our meeting today?
example_uz: Bugungi uchrashuvimizni unutganim uchun mendan jahlingiz chiqdimi?

definition_en: A house that is joined to another house on only one side.
example_en: We bought a lovely semi near the park for our growing family.
example_uz: Biz oilamiz uchun park yaqinidan chiroyli yarim ajratilgan uy sotib oldik.

definition_en: Small flat pieces of metal used as money by a country.
example_en: I keep all my loose coins in a small jar at home.
example_uz: Men barcha mayda tangalarimni uyda kichik idishda saqlayman.

definition_en: An amount including everything before any taxes or costs are taken away.
example_en: The company reported a high gross profit for the last financial year.
example_uz: Kompaniya o'tgan moliya yili uchun yuqori yalpi foyda haqida hisobot berdi.

definition_en: In a way that shows clear and firm feelings or beliefs.
example_en: I strongly believe that everyone deserves a chance to learn English.
example_uz: Men har kim ingliz tilini o'rganish imkoniyatiga loyiq ekanligiga qat'iy ishonaman.

definition_en: A card with a message of love sent to someone on February 14th.
example_en: She was happy to receive a surprise valentine from her best friend.
example_uz: U eng yaqin do'stidan kutilmagan valentinka olganidan xursand bo'ldi.

definition_en: A strong feeling of fear or shock caused by something very unpleasant.
example_en: She watched the movie in horror because the scenes were very scary.
example_uz: U filmni dahshat bilan tomosha qildi chunki sahnalar juda qo'rqinchli edi.

definition_en: Up to the time that something happens or finishes.
example_en: I will wait here till the bus arrives to take us home.
example_uz: Men avtobus bizni uyga olib ketguncha shu yerda kutaman.

definition_en: The right or permission to enter a place or join an organization.
example_en: The university sent him an official letter of admission for this year.
example_uz: Universitet unga shu yil uchun rasmiy qabul xatini yubordi.

definition_en: Chosen by voting to hold a public office or position.
example_en: The people elected a new president to lead the country yesterday.
example_uz: Xalq mamlakatni boshqarish uchun yangi prezident sayladi.

definition_en: Success in a battle, game, or competition against an opponent.
example_en: The team celebrated their great victory after the final football match.
example_uz: Jamoa final futbol o'yinidan so'ng o'zlarining buyuk g'alabasini nishonladi.

definition_en: Very small grains of crushed rock found on beaches and in deserts.
example_en: The children enjoyed building a large castle out of wet sand.
example_uz: Bolalar nam qumdan katta qal'a qurishdan zavqlandilar.

definition_en: The use of violence and fear to achieve political goals.
example_en: The international community is working together to fight against global terrorism.
example_uz: Xalqaro hamjamiyat global terrorizmga qarshi kurashish uchun birga ishlamoqda.

definition_en: A feeling of great happiness or pleasure.
example_en: Seeing her family again brought her a great deal of joy.
example_uz: Oila a'zolarini qayta ko'rish unga katta quvonch bag'ishladi.

definition_en: Used to describe the most important or common reason or part of something.
example_en: The meeting was mainly about how to improve the office environment.
example_uz: Uchrashuv asosan ofis muhitini qanday yaxshilash haqida edi.

definition_en: Connected with a group of people who share the same culture, race, or ancestors.
example_en: The school celebrates the diverse ethnic backgrounds of all its students.
example_uz: Maktab barcha o'quvchilarning turli etnik kelib chiqishini nishonlaydi.

definition_en: A group of people elected to make laws and discuss important government issues.
example_en: The parliament voted to pass the new law late last night.
example_uz: Parlament kecha kechasi yangi qonunni qabul qilish uchun ovoz berdi.

definition_en: A person who performs in plays, movies, or television shows.
example_en: The famous actor signed autographs for his fans after the show.
example_uz: Mashhur aktyor shoudan keyin muxlislari uchun dastxat qo'yib berdi.

definition_en: A large sea animal that has thick fur and lives in cold water.
example_en: We watched a seal swimming near the rocks at the beach.
example_uz: Biz sohil bo'yidagi qoyalar yaqinida suzayotgan tyulenni tomosha qildik.

definition_en: Coming after the fourth item in a series.
example_en: This is the fifth time I have visited this beautiful city.
example_uz: Bu mening ushbu go'zal shaharga beshinchi tashrif buyurishim.

definition_en: A person who is legally recognized as a member of a specific country.
example_en: Every citizen has the right to vote in the national elections.
example_uz: Har bir fuqaro milliy saylovlarda ovoz berish huquqiga ega.

definition_en: Standing or pointing straight up towards the sky.
example_en: The mountain wall was so vertical that nobody could climb it.
example_uz: Tog' devori shunchalik tik ediki, uni hech kimga chiqib bo'lmasdi.

definition_en: The act of making something right or the changes made to fix a mistake.
example_en: The editor made several corrections to the final draft of the report.
example_uz: Muharrir hisobotning oxirgi loyihasiga bir nechta tuzatishlar kiritdi.

definition_en: Relating to the way something is built or organized.
example_en: The old building suffered structural damage after the strong earthquake hit today.
example_uz: Bugun kuchli zilzila yuz berganidan keyin eski bino tuzilmaviy shikastlandi.

definition_en: Complete and total, without any doubt or exceptions.
example_en: It was an absolute disaster when the computer crashed during our presentation.
example_uz: Taqdimotimiz vaqtida kompyuter ishdan chiqqanida bu mutlaq falokat edi.

definition_en: Physical or mental conditions that limit a person's movements, senses, or activities.
example_en: The school offers special programs for students with learning disabilities.
example_uz: Maktab o'quv nogironligi bo'lgan talabalar uchun maxsus dasturlarni taklif qiladi.

definition_en: At any moment or on any occasion.
example_en: Feel free to call me anytime if you have any more questions.
example_uz: Agar yana savollaringiz bo'lsa, menga xohlagan vaqtda qo'ng'iroq qilishingiz mumkin.

definition_en: A particular type of matter with specific physical properties.
example_en: The liquid in the beaker turned into a solid white substance.
example_uz: Stakandagi suyuqlik qattiq oq moddaga aylandi.

definition_en: Statements that are not true, said on purpose to deceive others.
example_en: It is always better to tell the truth than to tell lies.
example_uz: Yolg'on gapirgandan ko'ra doimo haqiqatni aytgan ma'qul.

definition_en: A tube used to move water, gas, or other liquids from one place to another.
example_en: The water stopped flowing because there was a hole in the pipe.
example_uz: Quvurda teshik bo'lgani uchun suv oqishi to'xtadi.

definition_en: People who serve in an army and are trained to fight.
example_en: The soldiers marched through the town to protect the local people.
example_uz: Askarlar mahalliy aholini himoya qilish uchun shahardan o'tib ketishdi.

definition_en: A person who protects or is legally responsible for someone else.
example_en: She is the legal guardian of her younger brother after their parents died.
example_uz: Ota-onasi vafot etgandan so'ng u ukasining qonuniy vasiysi hisoblanadi.

definition_en: A talk given to a group of people to teach them about a subject.
example_en: During class today the professor delivered an interesting lecture on modern history.
example_uz: Bugungi darsda professor zamonaviy tarix bo'yicha qiziqarli ma'ruza o'qidi.

definition_en: A model that copies a real situation to study how it works.
example_en: This exercise is a simulation of actual battle conditions for the trainees.
example_uz: Ushbu mashg'ulot o'quvchilar uchun haqiqiy jangovar sharoitlarning simulyatsiyasidir.

definition_en: The way in which parts of something are arranged or organized.
example_en: The architect designed a new layout for the office to improve productivity.
example_uz: Me'mor unumdorlikni oshirish uchun ofisning yangi rejasi ustida ishladi.

definition_en: The ability to pay close attention to something you are doing.
example_en: Studying in a quiet place helps to improve your concentration.
example_uz: Tinch joyda o'qish diqqatni jamlashni yaxshilashga yordam beradi.

definition_en: To put something down carefully in a flat or resting position.
example_en: Please lay your books on the desk before we start the class.
example_uz: Iltimos darsni boshlashdan oldin kitoblaringizni stol ustiga qo'ying.

definition_en: A particular way of explaining or understanding something such as a rule or meaning.
example_en: Everyone had a different interpretation of the teacher's complex instructions today.
example_uz: Bugun o'qituvchining murakkab ko'rsatmalari haqida har kimning o'z talqini bor edi.

definition_en: An open, wooden floor built outside a house or on a ship.
example_en: We sat on the wooden deck to enjoy the warm summer evening.
example_uz: Biz issiq yoz oqshomidan zavqlanish uchun yog'och ayvonda o'tirdik.

definition_en: The past tense and past participle of teach, meaning to show someone how to learn.
example_en: My grandfather taught me how to fish when I was a child.
example_uz: Bobom bolaligimda menga baliq tutishni o'rgatgan edi.

definition_en: The act of making a process or system as effective or functional as possible.
example_en: The team focused on the optimization of their website to increase visitor speed.
example_uz: Jamoa tashrif buyuruvchilar tezligini oshirish uchun veb-saytlarini optimallashtirishga e'tibor qaratdi.

definition_en: Living and not dead, or something that is still active.
example_en: It is a miracle that they found the cat alive after the storm.
example_uz: Bo'rondan keyin mushukni tirik holda topishlari mo'jiza edi.

definition_en: A building used for religious worship.
example_en: They visited an ancient temple during their trip to the country.
example_uz: Ular mamlakatga qilgan safarlari davomida qadimiy ibodatxonaga tashrif buyurishdi.

definition_en: To show that something is definitely true by providing facts or evidence.
example_en: I will prove that my method is more effective than yours.
example_uz: Men usulim siznikidan samaraliroq ekanligini isbotlayman.

definition_en: Relating to the genes or the study of heredity in living things.
example_en: The researchers are studying the genetic causes of this rare disease.
example_uz: Tadqiqotchilar ushbu kamyob kasallikning genetik sabablarini o‘rganmoqdalar.

definition_en: Rules or laws that limit what people can do or how things can happen.
example_en: There are strict travel restrictions due to the recent public health concerns.
example_uz: Jamoat salomatligi bilan bog'liq so'nggi xavotirlar tufayli qat'iy sayohat cheklovlari mavjud.

definition_en: Having little distance between opposite sides or having very little body fat.
example_en: She wrote the note on a very thin piece of paper.
example_uz: U eslatmani juda yupqa qog'oz parchasi ustiga yozdi.

definition_en: To like one thing or person more than another.
example_en: Most people prefer to drink tea rather than coffee in the morning.
example_uz: Ko'pchilik ertalab kofega qaraganda choy ichishni afzal ko'radi.

definition_en: A long, narrow piece of raised ground or the top of a mountain range.
example_en: We walked along the mountain ridge to see the beautiful sunrise view.
example_uz: Quyosh chiqishining go'zal manzarasini ko'rish uchun tog' tizmasi bo'ylab yurdik.

definition_en: A piece of furniture with shelves or drawers used for storage.
example_en: Please put the clean dishes back into the kitchen cabinet.
example_uz: Iltimos, toza idishlarni oshxona shkafiga qaytarib qo'ying.

definition_en: A device that connects your computer or network to the internet.
example_en: You need to restart the modem to fix the internet connection issue.
example_uz: Internet aloqasidagi muammoni tuzatish uchun modemni qayta ishga tushirishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Relating to the hot and humid regions near the equator.
example_en: My favorite tropical fruits are pineapples and coconuts.
example_uz: Mening sevimli tropik mevalarim ananas va kokosdir.

definition_en: To bring things together or get items as a hobby.
example_en: The team uses special equipment to collect data on the weather.
example_uz: Jamoa ob-havo bo'yicha ma'lumotlarni yig'ish uchun maxsus uskunalardan foydalanadi.

definition_en: To risk money on the outcome of a game or event.
example_en: I bet you ten dollars that it will rain later today.
example_uz: Bugun keyinroq yomg'ir yog'ishiga senga o'n dollar tikaman.

definition_en: The way in which something is put together or its parts.
example_en: The chemical composition of the water was checked by the scientists.
example_uz: Suvning kimyoviy tarkibi olimlar tomonidan tekshirildi.

definition_en: Happening or existing in all parts of a country.
example_en: There was a nationwide search for the missing person last week.
example_uz: O‘tgan hafta bedarak yo‘qolgan shaxs uchun butunmamlakat bo‘ylab qidiruv e’lon qilindi.

definition_en: A quantity that has both a size and a specific direction.
example_en: Velocity is a vector defined by an object's speed and direction.
example_uz: Tezlik – bu jismning tezligi va yo‘nalishi bilan belgilanadigan vektordir.

definition_en: Used to express that something is certain or true.
example_en: I will definitely be at the meeting tomorrow morning at nine.
example_uz: Men ertaga ertalab soat to‘qqizdagi majlisda aniq bo‘laman.

definition_en: Having the hair removed from the skin with a razor.
example_en: He looked much younger after he had shaved his long beard.
example_uz: U uzun soqolini olib tashlaganidan keyin ancha yoshroq ko‘rindi.

definition_en: Something that reduces the bad effect of one thing on another.
example_en: The thick forest acts as a buffer against strong winter winds.
example_uz: Qalin o‘rmon qishki kuchli shamollarga qarshi himoya vazifasini o‘taydi.

definition_en: A color that is made by mixing red and blue.
example_en: She wore a beautiful purple dress to the wedding last night.
example_uz: U kecha to‘yga chiroyli binafsharang ko‘ylak kiyib bordi.

definition_en: The fact or state of living or having reality.
example_en: Scientists are searching for evidence of existence on other planets.
example_uz: Olimlar boshqa sayyoralarda mavjudlik belgilarini qidirmoqdalar.

definition_en: A spoken explanation of an event as it is happening, often on radio or television.
example_en: We listened to the football commentary while watching the match on TV.
example_uz: Biz o'yinni tomosha qilib futbol sharhini eshitdik.

definition_en: The process of coming to live permanently in a country that is not your own.
example_en: It took a long time to get through immigration at the airport.
example_uz: Aeroportda immigratsiya nazoratidan o'tish ancha vaqt oldi.

definition_en: A long system of pipes used to move oil, gas, or water across large distances.
example_en: A new oil pipeline has been opened from the Caspian Sea.
example_uz: Kaspiy dengizidan yangi neft quvuri ishga tushirildi.

definition_en: Used to say that something is not always true in every single case.
example_en: It is not necessarily true that children learn everything from their parents.
example_uz: Bolalar hamma narsani ota-onasidan o'rganadi deyish shart emas.

definition_en: The rules for how words are organized to create correct sentences in a language.
example_en: The teacher explained the complex syntax of the Latin language today.
example_uz: O'qituvchi bugun lotin tilining murakkab sintaksisini tushuntirib berdi.

definition_en: A word used in radio communication to confirm that you have heard and understood information.
example_en: I have received your message clearly, roger over to you now.
example_uz: Xabaringizni aniq qabul qildim rojer endi navbat sizda.

definition_en: The physical building or office where a person performs their daily professional tasks.
example_en: It is important to maintain a clean and safe workplace for everyone.
example_uz: Hamma uchun toza va xavfsiz ish joyini saqlash muhim.

definition_en: Something that is very good, impressive, or exciting.
example_en: We had an awesome time at the concert last night in town.
example_uz: Kecha shahardagi konsertda juda ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik.

definition_en: Relating to Mexico, its people, or its culture.
example_en: My favorite type of food to eat is spicy Mexican tacos.
example_uz: Men yoqtiradigan eng sevimli taom bu achchiq Meksika takolari.

definition_en: A violent accident where a vehicle hits another object or the ground.
example_en: The traffic was delayed because of a serious car crash nearby.
example_uz: Yaqin atrofda sodir bo'lgan jiddiy avtomobil avariyasi sababli tirbandlik yuzaga keldi.

definition_en: A free ride given to someone in a car to reach a destination.
example_en: Could you please give me a lift to the train station today?
example_uz: Iltimos bugun meni poyezd vokzaliga olib borib qo'ya olasizmi?

definition_en: To place a dead body into the ground or a tomb.
example_en: The famous writer was interred in the local church graveyard yesterday.
example_uz: Mashhur yozuvchi kecha mahalliy cherkov qabristoniga dafn etildi.

definition_en: With little space between things or involving a strong connection.
example_en: Finnish and Estonian are closely related languages with many similar words.
example_uz: Fin va eston tillari ko'plab o'xshash so'zlarga ega yaqin tillardir.

definition_en: Energy that comes out in the form of waves or particles.
example_en: The sun gives off radiation that can be harmful to our skin.
example_uz: Quyosh terimizga zarar yetkazishi mumkin bo'lgan nurlanish tarqatadi.

definition_en: A book in which you write down your daily experiences and thoughts.
example_en: She writes in her diary every evening before she goes to sleep.
example_uz: U har oqshom uxlashdan oldin o'z kundaligiga yozadi.

definition_en: In a way that is not joking and deserves to be thought about.
example_en: You should take his advice seriously because he has much experience.
example_uz: Uning maslahatiga jiddiy qarashingiz kerak chunki u ko'p tajribaga ega.

definition_en: The activity of firing a gun or other weapon at something.
example_en: The shooting at the local range is a very popular weekend sport.
example_uz: Mahalliy poligondagi otishma juda ommabop dam olish kuni sportidir.

definition_en: To stop sleeping or to make someone stop sleeping.
example_en: I woke up at seven o'clock to start my working day.
example_uz: Ish kunimni boshlash uchun soat yettida uyg'ondim.

definition_en: Not showing good judgment or having a lack of intelligence.
example_en: It was a stupid mistake to leave the front door open.
example_uz: Old eshikni ochiq qoldirish ahmoqona xato edi.

definition_en: An area of water near the coast where ships can stay safely.
example_en: Many large ships were anchored in the harbor during the storm.
example_uz: Bo'ron vaqtida ko'plab katta kemalar bandargohda langar tashlagan edi.

definition_en: Without being influenced by the current situation or negative consequences.
example_en: He decided to continue his work regardless of the harsh criticism.
example_uz: U qattiq tanqidga qaramasdan ishini davom ettirishga qaror qildi.
